titulo.alumno: Novice · Shopping and prices: Integrated conversation

intro: T1 · Beginner · Recognise letters, vocabulary and common phrases; understand basic grammar structures and short sentences from everyday life. Topic: Shopping and prices. Focus: Understanding interactions.

texto: Integrated conversation: friendly bargaining and asking at the market. In Thai local markets, interacting with a smile («ยิ้ม») and a warm tone is essential. If you want to ask permission to touch or look at an item: «ขอดูอันนี้ได้ไหมครับ/คะ». If you are buying several items, you can politely ask «ลดได้ไหมครับ/คะ» (Can you give me a discount?). Practise replying politely.
